description: This PHP source file generates and displays an HTML form for setting search criteria within the TestLink project. It initializes page settings, builds GUI components such as test project info, search filters, and importance options, and outputs the form using the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes arguments for the search GUI, mainly fetching test project ID and name from session variables and validating the test project ID.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares and returns a GUI data structure with test project settings, search filters, and importance options for the search form display.

parameters.name: argsObj
parameters.description: Object containing test project ID and name
